description: A flow diagram: the nodes and the edges between them. Leave x and y out and the diagram is laid out automatically.

title.description: A heading shown above the diagram.

direction.description: The direction of the automatic layout: top to bottom, left to right, bottom to top or right to left. The default is TB.

nodes.description: The boxes of the diagram. An id is used once.

edges.description: The arrows between the nodes. An edge whose source or target is not a node is dropped.

id.description: The id that edges refer to.

note.description: A second line under the label.

kind.description: Where the arrows attach: input starts a flow, output ends one, default does both. The default is default.

shape.description: The shape of the box. Use diamond for a decision. The default is rounded.

accent.description: The colour of the box, taken from the site's theme. The default is neutral.

url.description: An https or mailto address the box opens, after the user confirms.

x.description: The horizontal position. Give x and y on every node, or on none.

y.description: The vertical position. Give x and y on every node, or on none.

width.description: The width of the box in pixels.

height.description: The height of the box in pixels.

id.description: The id of the edge. One is made when it is left out.

source.description: The id of the node the arrow leaves.

target.description: The id of the node the arrow enters.

accent.description: The colour of the arrow. The default is neutral.

dashed.description: Draws the arrow as a dashed line.

animated.description: Moves the dashes along the arrow.

arrow.description: Draws the arrow head. The default is true.
